mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_tokens (user_id, token_hash, created_at, expires_at, revoked_at, revoke_reason, replaced_by_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{createdAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{revokedAt}, #{revokeReason}, #{replacedById})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, token_hash, created_at, expires_at, revoked_at, revoke_reason, replaced_by_id FROM refresh_tokens WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} FOR UPDATE
